en.title: 10 Animated Gems You Can Binge on Netflix Right Now
en.summary: Forget what you thought you knew about cartoons. This list dives into the sharpest, funniest, and most compelling animated sitcoms available on Netflix, proving animation is a powerhouse for adult storytelling.
en.body:
## 1. BoJack Horseman
This critically acclaimed series masterfully blends searing satire with profound emotional depth, following a washed-up sitcom star horse navigating Hollywood's underbelly. Its unflinching look at depression, addiction, and the search for meaning makes it a standout, especially in its later seasons where the narrative arcs become even more complex and heartbreaking.

## 2. Tuca & Bertie
With its vibrant, surreal animation and focus on female friendship, 'Tuca & Bertie' offers a unique blend of chaotic energy and heartfelt moments. The show tackles themes of anxiety, career struggles, and self-discovery with a distinctive visual flair and sharp wit that feels both fresh and relatable, particularly in its exploration of everyday absurdities.

## 3. Big Mouth
This coming-of-age comedy doesn't shy away from the awkwardness and hormonal chaos of puberty, using hormone monsters as a hilarious and often insightful metaphor. Its willingness to push boundaries with outrageous humor and surprisingly earnest storytelling makes it a must-watch for anyone who remembers navigating those turbulent teenage years.

## 4. Love, Death & Robots
This anthology series is a playground for diverse animation styles and mature storytelling, with each episode offering a self-contained narrative. From sci-fi epics to dark comedies, its strength lies in its sheer variety and the bold creative visions of its directors, consistently delivering thought-provoking and visually stunning shorts.

## 5. Dang!
Set to premiere in 2026 and starring Stephanie Hsu and Poppy Liu, this new adult animated series from the creative minds behind 'The Good Place' promises a fresh take on the genre. Expect the same blend of sharp writing and unexpected twists that made their previous work a hit, tackling complex themes with humor.

## 6. Bass X Machina
Expected in 2026, this animated series from Netflix is poised to explore unique narrative territories within the sci-fi genre. While details are still emerging, its potential for innovative storytelling and cutting-edge animation makes it one to watch for fans seeking something beyond the typical sitcom structure.

## 7. BeddyByes
This upcoming animated series, with 52 episodes planned, hints at a substantial narrative commitment from Netflix. As a flash animation project, it offers the potential for a distinct visual style and a deep dive into its characters' worlds, promising a binge-worthy experience for dedicated fans.

Bottom Line: Netflix's animated sitcoms offer a rich tapestry of humor, heart, and daring storytelling for adult viewers.

content_raw: Who says cartoons are just for kids? Here are 10 animated adult comedies worth streaming on Netflix right now.
